workshop_summary: Design session 1 for one Nordic loyalty programme: points, tiers, brand, migration and conversion.

decisions.decision: One points currency across all four markets, with points converting to vouchers and three tiers on top
Keep the banner programme names for customers for now (Aurora Plus in DK, Lumi Club in SE/NO/FI)

open_issues.issue: Migration approach: automatic migration or fresh consent
Points conversion rate between the programmes
Whether the Swedish birthday bonus stays as a local add-on

actions.action: Give a legal opinion on consent for migrating members
Pull usage data on the Swedish birthday bonus
Create a customer and store staff communication plan

risks.risk: Members leave if the points conversion feels unfair (4% of Gold members lost in 2021)
The conversion rate increases the points liability on the balance sheet
Automatic migration may breach consent rules for older Lumi Club members
The app team has no capacity until February, so launch slips

dependencies.dependent: Launch of one programme in one app
dependencies.depends_on: CRM consolidation in Q2 next year

dependencies.dependent: Promising a conversion rate to members
